parameters.name: IsPrivate
parameters.description: Specifies whether the target repository is private.

parameters.name: SourceRepoBranch
parameters.description: The branch of the source repository. Specify this parameter when you need to copy the source repository to the target repository.

parameters.name: SourceRepoName
parameters.description: The name of the source repository. Specify this parameter when you need to copy the source repository to the target repository.

parameters.name: SourceRepoOwner
parameters.description: The owner of the source repository, which can be a username or an organization name. Specify this parameter when you need to copy the source repository to the target repository.

parameters.name: TargetRepoName
parameters.description: The name of the target repository.

parameters.name: TargetRepoOwner
parameters.description: The owner of the target (new) repository. If SourceRepoOwner and SourceRepoName are specified, the source repository is copied to the target repository. Otherwise, only the target repository is created.
